messages.subject: WC-00130 - advice note (privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard, Karen,

Attached is our advice note on the Hartnell matter. In summary we recommend (a) hearing the grievance promptly and on its merits; (b) opening a protected conversation under s.111A; and (c) settling on commercial terms within the envelope set out at section 6.

The note is legally privileged - please keep distribution tight. Happy to talk it through on a call this week.

Tom
